newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures closed narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures closed narrowly mixed.

text.p: Rubber futures closed narrowly mixed in moderate trade on Friday amid uncertainty over market direction ahead of upcoming holidays in Malaysia and the U.S., brokers said.
Reports that stocks of Japan's natural rubber are expected to climb further by the end of September had little impact on the market.

"The news just came out today so I don't think there will be much impact here. But we will be watching the Japanese market closely for the rest of the (next) week to see what happens," a local broker said.

"Nothing much is happening today except for some weekend booksquaring. Most of us (traders) are going to Hatyai for the SICOM seminar on ring sessions on Saturday, so we will have to wait and see what happens next week in Japan," another broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, October RSS3 eased 0.75 cent to 129.25 U.S. cents a kg.
October RSS1 was unchanged from Thursday's settlement of 189.00 Singapore cents (US$1.35) a kg.
January/March TSR20 rose half a cent to 185.00 Singapore cents (US$1.32) a kg. (US$1-S$1.40) -- P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
